description:
The Cellebrite Government Cloud (CGC) is a SaaS solution that is operational within Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud. 

The CGC enables customers to extract and analyze digital forensic evidence from mobile devices, such as phones and tablets. Using Cellebrite’s Digital Forensics Suite and
Investigative Suite, customers can leverage features such as device unlocking, data extraction, data analysis, information sharing, and reporting without compromising the integrity or chain of custody of the mobile device.

description: Magnet One delivers secure digital forensics and investigative analysis capabilities within a FedRAMP High authorized cloud environment, enabling U.S. federal agencies to ingest, process, analyze, and manage digital evidence in compliance with federal security requirements. The offering combines Magnet One’s advanced evidence review and collaboration features with a rigorously controlled architecture, documented security controls, and continuous monitoring aligned to FedRAMP standards, supporting mission operations while maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive federal data.
